question: Chilika lake is situated in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Odisha**__.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Point__**

__
 
• Chilika is **Asia's largest and the world's second-largest lagoon.** 
 
• It lies on the east coast of India in the state of **Odisha**, separated from the mighty **Bay of Bengal** by a small strip of sand.
 
• Chilika Lake is a brackish water lake and a shallow lagoon with estuarine character spread across the districts of Puri, Khurda, and Ganjam.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shanthi Sagara Lake** | Davanagere District, Government of Karnataka.
 
• **Vembanad Lake** is the longest lake in India and the largest lake in Kerala.
 
• **Kolleru Lake** is one of the largest freshwater lakes in India located in state of Andhra Pradesh.
